## [1.4.0](https://github.com/archivesteak/pinterest-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-10-13)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Pinterest - Enable video download:** Close the Pin menu after downloading a video ([9d92b42](https://github.com/archivesteak/pinterest-patches/commit/9d92b42579ee98f9f262d99a7b16cc7dcaf8a93d))

### ✨ New Features

* **Pinterest - Customize long-press menu:** Add option to hide the "Send with <app>" item ([3481492](https://github.com/archivesteak/pinterest-patches/commit/348149288ff096a0d2f1d189de7998fb11b6292d))
* **Pinterest:** Add `Copy image` patch ([7eefde7](https://github.com/archivesteak/pinterest-patches/commit/7eefde7d43286e0a2825db6568d1164b2d4edeb3))
* **Pinterest:** Add `Share image with Android` patch ([ee0d393](https://github.com/archivesteak/pinterest-patches/commit/ee0d393ac4fde85a94d53656e3a82fb0bf3c7353))

patches.name: Copy image
patches.description: Adds "Copy image" below "Download image" in the Pin menu.

patches.name: Customize long-press menu
patches.description: Adds Download and Copy image to the menu shown when holding a Pin, and settings to choose which items the menu shows.

patches.name: Enable image download
patches.description: Restores the "Download image" option in the Pin menu and share sheet.

patches.name: Enable video download
patches.description: Adds "Download image" to the menu of video Pins and saves the video in the best available quality.

patches.name: Share image with Android
patches.description: Adds an option to share the image of a Pin with Android's share sheet, instead of the app's share menu.

patches.name: Show date posted
patches.description: Adds an option to show the date a Pin was posted, above its creator.
